description: Create a feature flag in a PostHog project.

active.description: Optional initial active state of the new feature flag.

key.description: The unique key of the new feature flag.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the new feature flag.

project_id.description: Optional ID of the PostHog project to create the flag in; when omitted, the POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID environment fallback is used.

name: create_feature_flag
